name: Lal Bahadur Shastri
role: Prime Minister of India from 1964 to 1966
contribution: An Indian politician and statesman who served as the prime minister of India from 1964 to 1966.
legacy: As prime minister, this person promoted the White revolution, a national campaign to increase the production and supply of milk, by supporting the Amul milk co-operative and creating the National Dairy Development Board.

checks.lead: Lal Bahadur Shastri (2 October 1904 – 11 January 1966) was an Indian politician and statesman who served as the  prime minister of India from 1964 to 1966. He previously served as home minister from 1961 to 1963.
